title: fix(runtime): refuse an OAuth agent's api-action forward by name from one credential × target-door table, and mark it in list_actions
body:
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
https://claude.ai/code/session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Fixes #28178

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:通过 OAuth 连接的 AI 智能体,运行一个会转发到其他接口的 `api` 类动作时,现在在转发之前就被明确拒绝,拒绝语句写清是哪个动作、转发到哪里、为什么不能跑、换什么方式能跑;`list_actions` 照样列出这些动作,但标上 `unavailable: { code, reason }`,智能体能直接告诉用户原因。
- 为什么改:OAuth 访问令牌只在 MCP 端点上有效,转发到数据接口或身份接口时目标认不出它,把已登录的智能体当成匿名用户,回一个「请先登录」的 401,用户和智能体都看不懂。维护者裁决(选项 B,6540286612):不放宽令牌的接受范围,改为按一张「凭据类型 × 目标接口」表在转发前点名拒绝。
- 风险与回滚:没有放宽任何接口接受的凭据,OAuth 令牌仍只在 MCP 端点有效;会话与 API Key 能跑的转发照旧能跑。API Key 调身份接口的既有拒绝(#28217)并入同一张表,语句不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`(`API_FORWARD_DOOR_ACCEPTS` 表与 `apiForwardCredentialRefusal`);`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`(`list_actions` 加标记);`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`(新增可选成员 `unavailable` 与导出类型)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts`,预期全绿,其中 `[#28178]` 一组 7 个用例覆盖表格逐格、两扇门的拒绝和 `list_actions` 的标记。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

An agent connected to MCP over OAuth holds an access token the platform honours on the MCP endpoint only. A same-origin `type: 'api'` action is forwarded with the caller's own credentials, so the forward reached every other target as nobody, and the agent got the target's anonymous `401` ("Sign in first") although it had authenticated. Ruling B (6540286612) on this card: refuse by name before the forward, from one table, and move no boundary.

- **One table, credential kind × target door** (`API_FORWARD_DOOR_ACCEPTS` in `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`): an identity route (`/api/v1/auth/…`) accepts a session only; the MCP endpoint a session, an API key or an OAuth token; every other same-origin target a session or an API key. `apiForwardCredentialKind` reads the admitted credential (`oauth` when the execution context carries `oauthScopes`, else the door's `admission.credential`); `apiForwardCredentialRefusal` reads the table.
- **Both run doors refuse before the forward.** `forwardApiAction` (shared by MCP `run_action` and REST `POST /actions/:object/:action`) answers `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` with a sentence naming the action, its declared target and what would let it run. The target is never called.
- **`list_actions` marks, it does not hide.** `buildMcpBridge.listActions` reads the same predicate and adds `unavailable: { code, reason }` with the same code and sentence `run_action` would answer. `McpActionSummary` gains the optional `unavailable` member and `@objectstack/mcp` exports the `McpActionUnavailable` type; the `list_actions` tool description says what the mark means.
- **The API-key lane (#28217) is now one cell of the table** (`api_key` × `identity`): its sentence is unchanged, and the listing marks it for an API-key caller too.
- **Unchanged:** where an OAuth access token is accepted (the MCP endpoint only; the dispatcher's `acceptOAuthAccessToken` is not touched), which credentials any target door accepts, and every forward the table allows.
- Docs: `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx` (the `list_actions` row and the `api` row). Changeset: `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/mcp`, `patch` (`Metadata-protocol: none`).

**One-PR exception.** The card was relabelled to `domain:spec` on triage's retriage answer because the MCP listing's exported shape widens; the `packages/mcp` half (`index.ts`, `mcp-http-tools.ts`) and the runtime table ride this one PR under that answer's declared file surface. No `packages/spec` file is touched.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts`, new `[#28178]` block: the table cell by cell; MCP `run_action` for an OAuth agent on a data-door-style target and on an identity-route target (named `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED`, nothing forwarded); the REST door's shared forward refusing the same caller; session and API-key callers of the same action still forwarded; `list_actions` marking every api action for the OAuth agent, nothing for a session, the identity-route action only for an API key. The `[#28217]` block passes unchanged on the moved cell.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/mcp-oauth-api-action-forward.dogfood.test.ts`: over a real OAuth access token on the booted showcase, the listing marks, `run_action` answers the named refusal and leaves the row untouched, the identity-route Ban action bans nobody, session and API-key lanes unchanged, and the boundary pin: the same token sent straight to the data door or an identity route is still refused.

## Acceptance notes

- The forward credential that would let an OAuth agent actually run these actions is decision card #28367 (option A, an ADR-0090 D10 amendment), not this PR.
- Independent review: none run (quota); the PR waits for the seat's contract-review hand-off.
